SHA-512. TRANSFER_WIDTH 0, 1 and 2 select 1, 2 and 4 bytes per transaction, and 2
is the reset value (`sep-programming.adoc`, DMA; `dma.hjson`, OPCODE,
TRANSFER_WIDTH). `secure_dma.adoc` has no table for these encodings. Where
`secure_dma.adoc` or `secure_dma.rdl` states the access type of a register, it
wins over `dma.hjson`; `dma.hjson` gives the text that they leave out.
A plain copy uses OPCODE 0 and width 2 unless the entry walks the widths.
The tests use 4-aligned addresses and sizes that are multiples of 4. An
address is aligned to the transfer width (`secure_dma.adoc`, SRC_ADDR_LO,
DST_ADDR_LO).
Source and destination footprints, guard words included, are disjoint and lie
inside BASE to LIMIT.
* Sentinel. Every byte of the sentinel word of a memory-to-memory transfer is
one byte value s that no source byte of that transfer takes: drawn source data
excludes s, and for a published hash vector s is a value that the vector does
not hold. So every byte that the transfer writes differs from the sentinel.
Drawn source words are unique within a transfer. The handshake entry draws its
sentinel from its reference run (<<sep_spi_dma_handshake_rand_test,entry 4.15>>).
* DMA transaction size. The specification states single-beat DMA transactions
(`fabric.adoc`, Top Level AXI4) and the width of each transaction
(`secure_dma.adoc`, TRANSFER_WIDTH). It does not state the AxSIZE that the
TL-UL to AXI4 path gives a narrow transaction, and it does not state the address bits [1:0] of a 1-byte or 2-byte transaction. At width encodings 0 and 1 the address checks grade AxADDR[31:2] and the WSTRB byte lanes, and log AxADDR[1:0]. The beat checks (AxLEN 0, beat
count, write byte count from WSTRB, read address step) read
the observation tap `dma_axi_req_probe_o`. AxSIZE is not
graded. The destination image is graded through the frontdoor.
* DMA chunks. The specification does not state whether one GO runs every chunk
of a multi-chunk memory-to-memory transfer or one GO runs one chunk (see
<<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>). A multi-chunk leg accepts both
readings: after a chunk end with DONE=0 and the engine idle, the leaf writes GO
again with INITIAL_TRANSFER=0. The number of GO writes is logged as
`go_writes` and not graded. Every wait for DONE has a bound, and a timeout
fails with `FAIL-DMA-TIMEOUT`.
* FIFO depth. The leaf finds the SPI FIFO depths at run time from STATUS and uses
them only to size stimulus. It never compares a depth with a value.
* Time. Every time relation is in core clocks, sck half-cycles or ratios. No
check uses an absolute frequency.
* Rx data at the pad. The specification does not state which line carries the
Rx bit at each speed (see <<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>). Rx data
is graded by word count. The bit content of Rx data at the pad is not graded.
* Disable vector. The vector stays at the harness value. SYS_DIS bit 0 is never
randomized, because it filters inbound traffic (`lifecycle_controller.adoc`,
Disable Vector Format).
* Tool and run mode. A `no_cpu` leaf uses target `lsu_stub_all_live`, joins the
testlist groups `cpu_stub` and `all`, and lives in `spi.toml` (SPI, the
SPI-to-DMA handshake included) or `system.toml` (DMA). Tool "both" means Verilator and VCS. Tool "VCS" means a
`tools = ["vcs"]` pin, because the leaf reads state after reset. A leg that
reads reset state on a four-state simulator is a VCS-only leg inside a
both-tools leaf. A leaf that asserts `rst_ni` runs with real fuse sense (no
`+skip_fuse_sense`).

[[sep_spi_pad_speed_dir_matrix_test]]
===== 4.7 `sep_spi_pad_speed_dir_matrix_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: SPI and DMA

*Run mode*: `no_cpu` (`lsu_stub_all_live`), `+skip_fuse_sense`, no `rst_ni` pulse, 4 seeds; tool: both (Verilator and VCS); testlist groups `cpu_stub` and `all`, file `spi.toml`, one testlist entry. The seed draws the long dummy leg with a weight of 1 in 4. The leg takes 2,097,152 core clocks, so a seed that draws it runs longer.

*Source Module*: `sep_spi_pad_speed_dir_matrix_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` for the register frontdoor over `s_axi` (CPU-LSU splice, approved), with the response code of every access. A test-side sampler reads the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` on each core clock (approved). It counts one sck cycle at each leading edge, an edge that leaves the idle level, while chip select is low. `OcahSpiFlash` (`ocah_spi_vip`) drives `spi_miso_i` as the Rx responder (approved); the bits it returns are not graded. No checker needs a proposed probe. No inject. No check is blocked.

*Randomization*: `SepSeededRng` from the run seed (RAND-REP). Dimensions: the order of the 16 cells; the LEN class of each legal cell and of each dummy segment, `len0` (LEN 0), `sub_word` (LEN 1), `word_multiple` (LEN 3, 15, 31, or 0x3FF for a dummy segment) or `non_multiple` (LEN 4, 16, 32, or a value up to 63 with LEN+1 not a multiple of 4), weighted toward `len0` and `word_multiple`, and the value inside the class; the CLKDIV class of each cell, `zero` (0), `small` (1 to 3) or `mid` (4 to 7), and the value inside the class; the chain shapes (2 to 6 segments, the speed and direction of each segment); the long dummy leg (weight 1 in 4); the TX words and the responder stream. One constraint holds: each of DIRECTION 1 and 3 has at least one cell in `word_multiple`, so that CHK-SPI-RXCNT grades both directions on every seed. Every seed walks all 16 cells, one short register-level segment each. `reseed = 4` samples other orders, classes, values inside a class, chains, long dummy draws and data. The LEN class, CLKDIV class and CSAAT=1 cells depend on the seed, so `sep_spi_seg_rand_cg` closes on a merge of regressions (<<sep-fcov-rand,SEP_FCOV>>). No single regression is claimed to fill them.

*Objective*: The SPI host command contract holds (`vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, COMMAND and ERROR_STATUS registers; `hw/sys/sep/doc/spi.adoc`, Features; later cites in this entry use the file names only). SPEED 0, 1 and 2 move LEN+1 bytes at one bit per data line per sck cycle on 1, 2 and 4 data lines, so a data segment takes (LEN+1)*8/lanes sck cycles and a dummy segment (DIRECTION 0) takes LEN+1 sck cycles. The host runs at single transfer rate and has no x8 lane group, so a DDR or x8 host gives another count. CSAAT joins segments under one chip-select assertion. SPEED 3, and DIRECTION 3 at SPEED 1 or 2, raise ERROR_STATUS.CMDINVAL. The lane that carries each bit is not graded (see <<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>).

*Test Coverage*: The 10 legal SPEED x DIRECTION cells as single segments with CSAAT=0, at LEN classes 0, 1, 3, 4, 15, 16, 31, 32 and a value up to 63, and LEN 0x3FF for dummy segments. The Rx word count at every speed when LEN+1 is a multiple of 4. A dummy segment with TXQD and RXQD both at least 1. Chains of 2 to 6 legal segments in which speed and direction change while chip select stays low. A long dummy segment (LEN 0xFFFFF at CLKDIV 0) on a seed that draws it. The 6 illegal cells (SPEED 3 with DIRECTION 0 to 3, and DIRECTION 3 at SPEED 1 and 2). The open tests `sep_spi_ot_flash_cmd_rand_test` and `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` drive SPEED 0 for data and grade SPEED 3 with DIRECTION 2 at the ERROR_STATUS level. That cell runs here as a control: it logs `CTL-SPI-ILLEGAL LOG`, prints no CHK-SPI-ILLEGAL line and fills no bin. This entry adds the cycle counts at SPEED 1 and 2, dummy segments, chains and the five other illegal cells. INTR_STATE.ERROR for a real CMDINVAL is graded in <<sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test_leg,entry 4.10>>. Functional coverage: `sep_spi_command_segment_cg` (`cp_speed_dir_legal`, `cp_chain_change`, `cp_fifo_effect`), `sep_spi_seg_rand_cg` (graded on a merge of regressions: `cp_len_x_kind`, `cp_csaat_x_dir`, `cp_clkdiv_x_speed`), `sep_spi_illegal_access_cg` (`cp_illegal_speed_dir`), `sep_spi_fifo_status_cg` (`cp_cmd_accept`) and `sep_spi_pad_rand_cg` (graded on a merge of regressions: `cp_mode_x_dir`, `cp_clkdiv_class`).

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Draw the cell order, the LEN class and the CLKDIV class of each cell and the value inside each class, the chain shapes, the long dummy choice, the TX words and the responder stream from the seed. Log the plan first (`PLAN seed=<n> ...`), with the class of every cell, the CSAAT=1 directions of the chains and `long_dummy=<0 or 1>`. Every wait in the steps below is a bounded wait; a timeout fails the check that the step feeds. A segment is done when the sampler has shown chip select low and then high (for a chain with CSAAT=1, high after the last segment) and a later STATUS read shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Every wait for a segment below is this bounded wait, so a STATUS read taken before the command starts does not end it. Before every COMMAND write the test polls STATUS until READY=1 (bounded). The SW_RST helper writes CONTROL.SW_RST=1 with the other fields kept, polls STATUS until TXEMPTY=1 and RXEMPTY=1, then writes CONTROL.SW_RST=0. The SPI clean state writes 1 to every bit of ERROR_STATUS and to INTR_STATE.ERROR, writes CSID=0, and runs the SW_RST helper.
. Start from the harness reset state. Write CONTROL with SPIEN=1, OUTPUT_EN=1, SW_RST=0 and both watermark fields at their reset values. Write CSID=0. Leave ERROR_ENABLE at its reset value 0x1F. Read ERROR_STATUS and INTR_STATE; both read 0.
. Single-segment leg: repeat steps 3 to 7 for each legal cell in the drawn order. Write CONFIGOPTS with CPOL=0, CPHA=0, FULLCYC=0, CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL and CSNIDLE at 0 and the drawn CLKDIV, while ACTIVE=0 and chip select is high.
. Poll STATUS until READY=1. Write COMMAND with the cell's SPEED and DIRECTION, the drawn LEN and CSAAT=0. For DIRECTION 0 and 2, read STATUS before the COMMAND and require RXEMPTY=1 (control for CHK-SPI-RXCNT).
. Service the segment until it is done. Write the TXDATA words that the segment needs (LEN+1 bytes rounded up to words), each after a STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0. For DIRECTION 1 and 3, read one RXDATA word after each STATUS read that shows RXFULL=1, and count the words read in the segment.
. After the segment is done, read STATUS for RXQD. For DIRECTION 1 and 3, the total Rx word count is the words read in the segment plus RXQD. Read RXDATA until STATUS shows RXEMPTY=1, each read after a STATUS read that shows RXEMPTY=0; the words read equal RXQD. For DIRECTION 0 and 2, RXQD reads 0. When LEN+1 is not a multiple of 4, the Rx word count is read and not graded.
. Compare the sck cycle count that the sampler took for the segment with the expected count. Read ERROR_STATUS; it reads 0. Run the SW_RST helper.
. Dummy and FIFO leg. Run the SW_RST helper. Write one TXDATA word with no COMMAND. Run a 4-byte Rx segment (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0) and do not read RXDATA. After the segment is done, read STATUS; TXQD and RXQD are each at least 1 (control; else CTRL-MISSING). Log both values. Run a dummy segment (DIRECTION 0, a LEN of the drawn class of this segment, a drawn SPEED from 0 to 2, CSAAT=0). After the segment is done, read TXQD and RXQD again. Read RXDATA until RXEMPTY=1 and run the SW_RST helper.
. Chain leg. Control for the sampler: write two legal dummy commands (DIRECTION 0, a drawn LEN, CSAAT=0 on both) back to back, each after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, and wait until the sampler has shown chip select low and then high twice and a STATUS read shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Require that the sampler saw chip select rise between the two low windows, else CTRL-MISSING. Then, for each drawn chain, write CONFIGOPTS (drawn CLKDIV) while ACTIVE=0. Build the chain from 2 to 6 legal segments with at least one change of speed or of direction between neighbours. Data segments in a chain have LEN+1 a multiple of 4, so the word count does not depend on how a partial word packs across segments. Write each COMMAND after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, with CSAAT=1 on every segment except the last, which has CSAAT=0. The depth of the command queue is not claimed, so interleave the data with the COMMAND writes: between the COMMAND writes and while waiting for READY=1, write the TXDATA words of the Tx segments already written, in order, each after a STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0, and read RXDATA as in step 5 for the Rx segments already written. After the last COMMAND, write the remaining TXDATA words and read RXDATA as in step 5 until the chain is done (the sampler shows chip select high after the last segment, and STATUS shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0). Read ERROR_STATUS; it reads 0. Run the SW_RST helper.
. Long dummy leg, on a seed that draws it. Write CONFIGOPTS with CLKDIV 0 while ACTIVE=0. After a STATUS read that shows READY=1, write COMMAND with DIRECTION 0, SPEED 0, LEN 0xFFFFF and CSAAT=0. Wait until the segment is done and take the sck cycle count.
. Illegal cells, as error injection. For each of the 6 illegal cells in the drawn order, run the SPI clean state and poll STATUS until READY=1. Write COMMAND with the cell's SPEED and DIRECTION, a drawn LEN and CSAAT=0, and push no TX data. Point: COMMAND write over the register bus. Kind: reserved SPEED encoding, or bidirectional at dual or quad. Expected response: ERROR_STATUS.CMDINVAL=1 and no other ERROR_STATUS bit (`spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_STATUS). Poll ERROR_STATUS until CMDINVAL reads 1, then require the value 0x08. The cell SPEED 3 with DIRECTION 2 is a control: it logs `CTL-SPI-ILLEGAL LOG seed=<n> speed=3 dir=2 err_status=0x<v>`, a value other than 0x08 fails the leaf, and it prints no CHK-SPI-ILLEGAL line.
. After each illegal cell, run the SPI clean state and poll STATUS until READY=1. Write one legal control command (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 0, a drawn LEN, CSAAT=0) and wait until the segment is done. Read ERROR_STATUS; it reads 0.

*Checkers*:

[cols="2,5",options="header"]
|===
|Checker |Contract
|CHK-SPI-CELL
|Per legal cell, the sck cycle count on the pad while chip select is low equals (LEN+1)*8/lanes for DIRECTION 1, 2 and 3 and LEN+1 for DIRECTION 0, with lanes 1, 2 and 4 at SPEED 0, 1 and 2, and ERROR_STATUS reads 0 after the segment (`spi.adoc`, Features; `spi_controller.adoc`, COMMAND). A host with a DDR mode, an x8 lane group or the wrong lane count gives another count and fails. A legal cell that sets any ERROR_STATUS bit fails. Anchor: the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` (approved) and an ERROR_STATUS readback. Control for "a legal cell never sets CMDINVAL": the illegal cells of the same seed set it (CHK-SPI-ILLEGAL). Evidence: one line per legal cell, `CHK-SPI-CELL PASS seed=<n> speed=<s> dir=<d> len=<LEN> csaat=<c> clkdiv=<d> sck_cycles=<got> expect=<exp> err_status=0x00`.
|CHK-SPI-RXCNT
|For DIRECTION 1 and 3 with LEN+1 a multiple of 4, the Rx word count equals (LEN+1)/4 at every speed. The count comes from two readings that must agree: the RXDATA words read (in the segment and in the drain) and RXQD with ACTIVE=0. A host that returns more or fewer words fails. Anchor: STATUS and RXDATA readback over the frontdoor (approved). Control: a Tx-only or dummy segment that starts with RXEMPTY=1 leaves RXQD at 0. A seed in which no DIRECTION 1 cell and no DIRECTION 3 cell has LEN+1 a multiple of 4 logs CTRL-MISSING and fails. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-RXCNT PASS seed=<n> speed=<s> dir=<d> bytes=<b> words=<w> rxqd=<q> expect=<(LEN+1)/4> control_nonrx_rxqd=0`.
|CHK-SPI-DUMMY
|A dummy segment leaves TXQD and RXQD unchanged, because it moves no data (`spi_controller.adoc`, COMMAND.DIRECTION). A host that pops a TX word or pushes an RX word for a dummy segment fails. Anchor: STATUS readback with ACTIVE=0 before and after the segment. Control: both counters are at least 1 before the segment, else CTRL-MISSING. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-DUMMY PASS seed=<n> txqd_before=<a> txqd_after=<a> rxqd_before=<b> rxqd_after=<b>`.
|CHK-SPI-CHAIN
|With CSAAT=1 on every segment but the last, chip select stays low for the whole chain, the sck cycle count of the chain equals the sum of the segment counts, and chip select is high when the chain is done (`spi_controller.adoc`, COMMAND.CSAAT). A host that raises chip select between segments shows a mid-chain rise and fails. Anchor: the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` (approved). Control for "never rises mid-chain": in the same seed the sampler sees chip select rise between the two back-to-back CSAAT=0 transactions of the control step and at the chain end, so the sampler is shown to see a rise; the chain has at least 2 segments and at least one change of speed or direction, else CTRL-MISSING. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-CHAIN PASS seed=<n> segs=<k> sck_cycles_in_chain=<got> expect=<sum> cs_dropped_mid=0 cs_high_after=1 control_cs_rise_between_csaat0=1`.
|CHK-SPI-ILLEGAL
|Each of the five graded illegal cells (every illegal cell except SPEED 3 with DIRECTION 2, which is a control here) sets ERROR_STATUS.CMDINVAL and no other bit, and the control command after the SPI clean state reads ERROR_STATUS 0 (`spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_STATUS; `COMMAND.SPEED`, `COMMAND.DIRECTION`). A host that accepts a reserved cell, or that stays in error after the clean state, fails. Anchor: ERROR_STATUS readback (approved frontdoor). Control for "a legal cell never sets CMDINVAL": the legal cells of the same seed read ERROR_STATUS 0. INTR_STATE.ERROR is graded in entry 4.10. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-ILLEGAL PASS seed=<n> speed=<s> dir=<d> err_status=0x08 control_err_status=0x00`.
|CHK-SPI-LONGDUMMY
|The long dummy segment (LEN 0xFFFFF, DIRECTION 0) gives LEN+1 = 1,048,576 sck cycles. A host that truncates the 20-bit LEN field gives a lower count and fails. Anchor: the pad ports (approved). The check runs only on a seed that draws the long dummy leg; on any other seed it does not count in k. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-LONGDUMMY PASS seed=<n> cycles=1048576`.
|===

*Pass Criteria*: Every named checker PASSes. UVM_ERROR == 0.

*Scope limit*: The data line that carries each bit, and the bit content of Rx data, are not graded. The packing of a partial word in the TX and RX FIFOs is not graded. CONFIGOPTS stays at CPOL=0, CPHA=0 and FULLCYC=0; the pad timing of CONFIGOPTS is graded in <<sep_spi_pad_timing_cfg_rand_test,entry 4.8>>. INTR_STATE.ERROR for a real CMDINVAL is graded in entry 4.10. The open tests `sep_spi_ot_flash_cmd_rand_test` and `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` own the cell SPEED 3 with DIRECTION 2 at the ERROR_STATUS level; here it is a control that logs `CTL-SPI-ILLEGAL LOG` and is not graded.

'''''

[[sep_spi_pad_timing_cfg_rand_test]]
===== 4.8 `sep_spi_pad_timing_cfg_rand_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: SPI and DMA

*Run mode*: `no_cpu` (`lsu_stub_all_live`), `+skip_fuse_sense`, no `rst_ni` pulse, 3 seeds; tool: both (Verilator and VCS); testlist groups `cpu_stub` and `all`, file `spi.toml`. Every run grades two mode cells.

*Source Module*: `sep_spi_pad_timing_cfg_rand_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` for the register frontdoor over `s_axi` (CPU-LSU splice, approved). A test-side sampler reads the pad ports `spi_sck_o`, `spi_cs_n_o` and `spi_mosi_o` on each core clock (approved). `spi_mosi_o` is data line `sd[0]`. No responder is attached; `spi_miso_i` stays at its testbench default and Rx bit content is not graded. No proposed probe. No inject. No check is blocked.

*Randomization*: `SepSeededRng` from the run seed (RAND-REP). Every seed grades two mode cells (CPOL x CPHA x FULLCYC). The seed draws the first mode cell from the 8. The second mode cell has the other CPOL value, the other CPHA value and a drawn FULLCYC, so every seed grades both sck idle levels and both CPHA values. Dimensions: the two mode cells and their order, and per mode cell CLKDIV a (0 to 15), CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL and CSNIDLE (0 to 15 each) and CLKDIV b for the ratio leg (0 to 15, not equal to a). The CLKDIV and CSN draws are weighted toward 0 and 15. The control run of every mode cell writes CSNIDLE=0. `reseed = 3` samples other mode cells, orders and values. The plan shape (two mode cells, each with a control run, a graded run and a ratio leg) is the same on every seed. The 8 mode cells, the CLKDIV and CSN classes and the CPHA=1 edge depend on the seed and close on a merge of regressions (<<sep-fcov-rand,SEP_FCOV>>); with two of the 8 mode cells per seed and 3 seeds, about 8 x ln 8 / 6, so about three regressions, fill the 8 mode cells.

*Objective*: The pad effect of CONFIGOPTS holds (`vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, CONFIGOPTS register; later cites in this entry use the file name only). sck idles at the CPOL level. The sck period is 2*(CLKDIV+1) core clocks. Chip select falls (CSNLEAD+1) half sck cycles before the first sck edge, rises (CSNTRAIL+1) half sck cycles after the last sck edge, and stays high at least (CSNIDLE+1) half sck cycles between commands, where a half sck cycle is CLKDIV+1 core clocks. Tx data changes on the trailing sck edge when CPHA=0 and on the leading edge when CPHA=1. The core clock frequency is not stated, so the test grades a period ratio between two CLKDIV values and no absolute frequency (`hw/sys/sep/doc/clk_rst.adoc`).

*Test Coverage*: CPOL x CPHA x FULLCYC (two mode cells per seed, one at each CPOL value and each CPHA value; the 8 mode cells close on a merge of regressions; FULLCYC is written and its Rx sampling point is not graded), CLKDIV 0 to 15, CSNLEAD and CSNTRAIL 0 to 15, CSNIDLE 1 to 15 in the graded run (step 4 raises it above the control gap, so CSNIDLE 0 is not graded), the sck idle level, the sck period, the chip-select lead, trail and idle gap, the Tx data edge at CLKDIV 1 or more, and the period ratio of two CLKDIV values. The cell CPHA=1 with FULLCYC=1 is logged and not graded, because `spi_controller.adoc` (CONFIGOPTS) gives it a shift edge that differs from the general CPHA text. The open test `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` grades CONFIGOPTS read-back only; the pad effect is graded here. Functional coverage: `sep_spi_pad_interface_cg` (`cp_pad_timing_ok`) and `sep_spi_pad_rand_cg` (`cp_idle_level`; graded on a merge of regressions: `cp_mode8`, `cp_mode_x_dir`, `cp_clkdiv_class`, `cp_csn_class`, `cp_cpha_edge`).

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Draw the two mode cells and their order and, per mode cell, CLKDIV a, CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL, CSNIDLE and CLKDIV b from the seed. Log the plan first (`PLAN seed=<n> ...`). Steps 3 to 7 run once for each of the two mode cells in the drawn order, with the draws of that mode cell, and each checker prints one PASS line per mode cell with `mode=<cpol><cpha><fullcyc>` in it. Every wait in the steps below is a bounded wait; a timeout fails the check that the step feeds. A segment is done when the sampler has shown chip select low and then high (for a chain with CSAAT=1, high after the last segment) and a later STATUS read shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Every wait for a segment below is this bounded wait, so a STATUS read taken before the command starts does not end it. Before every COMMAND write the test polls STATUS until READY=1 (bounded). For the pair of transactions of steps 3 and 5, the pair is done when the sampler has shown chip select low and then high twice and a STATUS read shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0.
. Start from the harness reset state. Write CONTROL with SPIEN=1, OUTPUT_EN=1 and SW_RST=0. Write CSID=0. Read ERROR_STATUS; it reads 0.
. Control run. With ACTIVE=0, write CONFIGOPTS with the drawn mode cell, CLKDIV a, the drawn CSNLEAD and CSNTRAIL, and CSNIDLE=0. Never write CONFIGOPTS while a transaction runs. Write the TXDATA words of a Tx segment of 16 bytes (4 words, each with bytes that alternate 0x55 and 0xAA). After a STATUS read that shows READY=1, write COMMAND for that Tx segment (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0). Then poll STATUS until a read shows READY=1 and ACTIVE=1, so that the first segment is still active, and write COMMAND for an Rx segment of 4 bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0) right after that read. When a read shows READY=1 and ACTIVE=0 before the Rx COMMAND is written, repeat the control run with a Tx segment twice as long (at most 3 doublings, a test parameter, while TXFULL=0 allows the words); when ACTIVE=0 still, log CTRL-MISSING and fail. Wait until the pair is done. Read RXDATA until RXEMPTY=1, each read after a STATUS read that shows RXEMPTY=0. Take g0, the number of core clocks that chip select stays high between the two transactions.
. Raise CSNIDLE. When (CSNIDLE+1)*(a+1) is not above g0, set CSNIDLE to the smallest value in 0 to 15 whose minimum (CSNIDLE+1)*(a+1) is above g0. When even the value 15 does not give a minimum above g0, log CTRL-MISSING and fail.
. Graded run. With ACTIVE=0, write CONFIGOPTS with the drawn mode cell, CLKDIV a, CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL and the CSNIDLE of step 4. Run the same pair of transactions as in step 3, with the same segment lengths and the same write order, so that the Rx COMMAND is queued while the Tx segment is active. From the sampler, take: every sck period inside the two chip-select-low windows; the lead and the trail of each transaction; the chip-select-high gap between the two transactions; the sck level in every chip-select-high window that starts after the first transaction ends (the gap and the interval after the second transaction); the number of sck toggles in each chip-select-low window; and the Tx data changes on `spi_mosi_o`.
. Ratio leg. With ACTIVE=0, write CONFIGOPTS with the mode cell of step 5, CLKDIV a, and CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL and CSNIDLE as in step 5. Write the TXDATA word first, with bytes that alternate 0x55 and 0xAA as in step 3, so that step 7 has at least two data changes after the first bit when it grades this run; then after a STATUS read that shows READY=1 write COMMAND for one Tx segment of 4 bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0), wait until the segment is done, and take the sck period as period_a. With ACTIVE=0, write CONFIGOPTS with CLKDIV b and the other fields unchanged. Run the same Tx segment in the same order, wait until the segment is done, and take the period as period_b.
. Grade the Tx data edge on the run whose CLKDIV is 1 or more: the graded run of step 5 when a is at least 1, else the CLKDIV b run of step 6. Take the data changes on `spi_mosi_o` after the first bit. The first bit is exempt, because it is set up before the first sck edge. A change is "in the stated half" when it lies at or after the stated sck edge and before the next sck edge: the trailing edge for CPHA=0 and the leading edge for CPHA=1. In the cell CPHA=1 with FULLCYC=1, do not grade; log the cell as not graded and ambiguous. When the graded run has fewer than two data changes after the first bit, log CTRL-MISSING and fail.

*Checkers*:

[cols="2,5",options="header"]
|===
|Checker |Contract
|CHK-SPI-IDLE-LEVEL
|sck is at the CPOL level while chip select is high, in every chip-select-high window of the graded run that starts after the first transaction ends (`spi_controller.adoc`, CONFIGOPTS.CPOL). A host that idles at the other level fails. Anchor: the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` (approved). Control: the chip-select-low window of the same transaction shows sck toggles, so the level is read in a design that drives sck. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-IDLE-LEVEL PASS seed=<n> cpol=<c> level=<l> windows=<w> control_toggles=<t>`.
|CHK-SPI-PERIOD
|Every sck period in the graded run equals 2*(CLKDIV+1) core clocks exactly (`spi_controller.adoc`, CONFIGOPTS.CLKDIV). The sampler reads every core clock, so no tolerance applies. A host with another divider or a half-rate sck fails. Anchor: the pad ports (approved). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-PERIOD PASS seed=<n> clkdiv=<d> periods=<k> period_clk=<got> expect=<2*(d+1)>`.
|CHK-SPI-RATIO
|The two runs of the ratio leg give period_a*(b+1) equal to period_b*(a+1) exactly, with a not equal to b. A host whose period does not scale with CLKDIV fails. No absolute frequency enters the check. Anchor: the pad ports (approved). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-RATIO PASS seed=<n> a=<a> b=<b> period_a=<pa> period_b=<pb> lhs=<pa x (b+1)> rhs=<pb x (a+1)>`.
|CHK-SPI-CSN
|In the graded run, the lead of each transaction equals (CSNLEAD+1)*(CLKDIV+1) core clocks, the trail equals (CSNTRAIL+1)*(CLKDIV+1), and the chip-select-high gap is at least (CSNIDLE+1)*(CLKDIV+1) (`spi_controller.adoc`, CONFIGOPTS.CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL, CSNIDLE). Control for the minimum: the control run gives the natural gap g0 with CSNIDLE=0, and the graded CSNIDLE has a minimum above g0, so a host that ignores CSNIDLE shows a gap of g0 and fails. In both runs the Rx COMMAND is written while the Tx segment is active (the READY=1 read shows ACTIVE=1), so the gap is the one the host produces between queued commands and does not include bus latency. Anchor: the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` (approved). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-CSN PASS seed=<n> clkdiv=<d> lead=<got>/<exp> trail=<got>/<exp> idle_gap=<got> min=<exp> control_gap=<g0>`.
|CHK-SPI-CPHA
|At CLKDIV 1 or more, each Tx data change after the first bit lies in the half sck period that starts at the stated edge, and none lies in the half period that starts at the other edge (`spi_controller.adoc`, CONFIGOPTS.CPHA). A host with the opposite phase fails. Anchor: the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_mosi_o` (approved). Control: the run has at least two data changes after the first bit, else CTRL-MISSING. The cell CPHA=1 with FULLCYC=1 does not run this check; the leaf logs `OBS-SPI-CPHA seed=<n> cpha=1 fullcyc=1 graded=0 ambiguous=1` and the check does not count in k. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-CPHA PASS seed=<n> cpha=<p> clkdiv=<d> edge=<trailing or leading> in_stated_half=<k> in_other_half=0`.
|===

*Pass Criteria*: Every named checker PASSes. UVM_ERROR == 0.

*Scope limit*: The FULLCYC Rx sampling point, the CPHA edge at CLKDIV 0, the cell CPHA=1 with FULLCYC=1, the sck level before the first command that follows a CONFIGOPTS write, any absolute sck frequency, and the Rx bit content are not graded. Only SPEED 0 is driven; the cycle counts of the other speeds are graded in <<sep_spi_pad_speed_dir_matrix_test,entry 4.7>>. The open test `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` owns the CONFIGOPTS read-back.

'''''

[[sep_spi_fifo_stall_watermark_rand_test]]
===== 4.9 `sep_spi_fifo_stall_watermark_rand_test`

*Phase*: 3

*Area*: SPI and DMA

*Run mode*: `no_cpu` (`lsu_stub_all_live`), `+skip_fuse_sense`, no `rst_ni` pulse, 3 seeds; tool: both (Verilator and VCS); testlist groups `cpu_stub` and `all`, file `spi.toml`

*Source Module*: `sep_spi_fifo_stall_watermark_rand_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` for the register frontdoor over `s_axi` (CPU-LSU splice, approved). A test-side sampler reads the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` on each core clock (approved). No responder is attached; `spi_miso_i` stays at its testbench default and Rx bit content is not graded. No checker needs a proposed probe. No inject. No check is blocked.

*Randomization*: `SepSeededRng` from the run seed (RAND-REP). Dimensions: the SPEED of the stall legs (0, 1 or 2), the TX arrival gap, the Rx read gap and burst length, the payload words, the mid TX watermark value (2 up to the TX depth minus 1), the TX control watermark (1, the mid value or the TX depth), the mid RX watermark value (2 up to the RX depth minus 2), the order of the RX watermark values and CLKDIV (1 to 3). Every seed runs the stall legs at the drawn SPEED, the TX watermarks 0 and the TX depth plus 1 (when that is at most 255) with the drawn control watermark, and the RX watermarks 0, 1 and the mid value. The graded TX cells are TX_WATERMARK 0 and the TX depth plus 1. The classes "depth" and "depth plus 1" resolve against the depth that the leaf finds in the run. `reseed = 3` samples other speeds, gaps, bursts, payloads, control watermarks, mid values and CLKDIV values. The plan of legs is the same on every seed. The stall x SPEED cells depend on the seed and close on a merge of regressions (<<sep-fcov-rand,SEP_FCOV>>).

*Objective*: The FIFO status contract holds (`vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, CONTROL and STATUS registers; later cites in this entry use the file name only). TXSTALL and RXSTALL assert, and sck pauses, while an active segment waits for TX data or for RX space. STATUS.TXWM is set while TXQD is below TX_WATERMARK. STATUS.RXWM is set while RXQD exceeds RX_WATERMARK. Each TXDATA write and each RXDATA read moves one 32-bit word. CMDQD counts the accepted commands. TXFULL, TXEMPTY, RXFULL and RXEMPTY follow the occupancy, and a FIFO is never full and empty together.

*Test Coverage*: TXSTALL and RXSTALL at a drawn speed (0, 1 or 2) on every seed, with the three speeds closing on a merge of regressions; TX watermark cells at watermark 0 and above the depth; RX watermark cells on both sides of each of the thresholds 0, 1 and a mid value; each RXDATA read; CMDQD with a held head segment; TXFULL while a segment is active; RXFULL below and at the RX depth while the host is idle; the four flags TXFULL, TXEMPTY, RXFULL and RXEMPTY. The open test `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` grades TXWM and TXQD at TX_WATERMARK 2 to 8, and the open test `sep_spi_ot_dma_tx_test` grades STATUS.TXWM against TXQD at TX_WATERMARK 4. The TX cells at watermark 1, a mid value and the TX depth are controls here: the leaf runs one of them, drawn per seed, logs it with `OBS-SPI-WM` and grades nothing. Entry 4.7 grades the Rx word count and RXQD (CHK-SPI-RXCNT), so TXQD and RXQD at idle are logged and not graded here. This entry adds watermark 0, a watermark above the depth, the RX axis, the stall flags, the RXQD step per read and RXFULL. The overflow and underflow kinds are graded in <<sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test_leg,entry 4.10>>. Functional coverage: `sep_spi_fifo_status_cg` (`cp_flag`, `cp_stall`, `cp_ready_x_active`, `cp_cmd_accept`, `cp_tx_write_space`, `cp_rx_read`, `cp_depth_counter`), `sep_spi_fifo_rand_cg` (`cp_txwm`, `cp_rxwm`; graded on a merge of regressions: `cp_stall_x_speed`) and `sep_spi_pad_rand_cg` (graded on a merge of regressions: `cp_clkdiv_class`).

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Draw the SPEED of the stall legs, the TX arrival gap, the Rx read gap and burst, the payload words, CLKDIV, the two mid watermark values, the TX control watermark and the RX watermark order from the seed. Log the plan first (`PLAN seed=<n> ...`). "The drawn speed" in the steps below is that SPEED. Every wait in the steps below is a bounded wait; a timeout fails the check that the step feeds. The stall window is 8 sck periods, a test parameter. A segment is done when the sampler has shown chip select low and then high (for a chain with CSAAT=1, high after the last segment) and a later STATUS read shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Every wait for a segment below is this bounded wait, so a STATUS read taken before the command starts does not end it. Before every COMMAND write the test polls STATUS until READY=1 (bounded). Run the SPI clean state before every leg. The SW_RST helper writes CONTROL.SW_RST=1 with the other fields kept, polls STATUS until TXEMPTY=1 and RXEMPTY=1, then writes CONTROL.SW_RST=0. The SPI clean state writes 1 to every bit of ERROR_STATUS and to INTR_STATE.ERROR, writes CSID=0, and runs the SW_RST helper.
. Start from the harness reset state. Write CONTROL with SPIEN=1, OUTPUT_EN=1, SW_RST=0, TX_WATERMARK=0 and RX_WATERMARK=0x7F. Write CONFIGOPTS with CPOL=0, CPHA=0, FULLCYC=0, CSNLEAD, CSNTRAIL and CSNIDLE at 0 and the drawn CLKDIV. Write CSID=0. Read STATUS; log that TXEMPTY and RXEMPTY are set.
. TX depth. With no COMMAND, write TXDATA words one at a time, each after a STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0 and ACTIVE=0. Stop at the first STATUS read that shows TXFULL=1, and never write once more. The number of words written is the TX depth; log it. Run the SW_RST helper.
. RX stall. Poll STATUS until READY=1, then write COMMAND for an Rx segment of 1032 bytes (the drawn speed, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0), which is more words than the 8-bit RXQD counts. Read no RXDATA. Count the sck edges from the COMMAND write until a STATUS read shows RXFULL=1 and RXSTALL=1; this count is the control and must be above 0, else CTRL-MISSING. Open the stall window at that read and count the sck edges in it. Read STATUS at the start and at the end of the window; both reads show RXFULL=1 and RXSTALL=1 and the same RXQD. Log that RXQD as s. Because RXQD may be an underestimate while ACTIVE=1, s is a lower bound of the RX depth and only the start of the search in step 5. When the two RXQD values differ, log CTRL-MISSING and fail.
. Drain the RX FIFO in bursts of the drawn length with the drawn gap, each RXDATA read after a STATUS read that shows RXEMPTY=0, until the segment is done and RXEMPTY=1. The drain reads 258 words in total, the words of the 1032 bytes. Then find the RX depth with ACTIVE=0: for r from the larger of 1 and s minus 1 upward, run the SPI clean state, run an Rx segment of 4*r bytes (the drawn speed, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0) with no RXDATA read, wait until the segment is done, and read STATUS. The first r whose read shows RXFULL=1 is the RX depth R; log it. Every smaller r shows RXFULL=0; log RXQD with `OBS-SPI-QD`. When r reaches 255, the largest the 8-bit RXQD holds, with no RXFULL=1, log CTRL-MISSING and fail. Read RXDATA until RXEMPTY=1 and run the SW_RST helper.
. TX stall. Draw m (the segment length in words, 2 up to the TX depth) and m1 (1 up to m minus 1). After a STATUS read that shows READY=1, write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4*m bytes (the drawn speed, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0). Write m1 TXDATA words. Wait until the sampler shows 4*m1*8/lanes sck cycles. Poll STATUS until TXSTALL=1. Open the stall window at that read and count the sck edges in it; read STATUS at the start and at the end of the window, and both show TXSTALL=1. Hold for the drawn gap after the window. Write the remaining m minus m1 words. Poll STATUS until TXSTALL=0. Wait until the segment is done and take the sck cycle count of the segment.
. TX stall control. Run the SPI clean state. Write all m TXDATA words, then after a STATUS read that shows READY=1 write the same COMMAND. Read STATUS repeatedly until the segment is done. Every read that the sampler shows taken while chip select is low shows TXSTALL=0; at least one read is taken while chip select is low, else CTRL-MISSING. Take the sck cycle count.
. TX watermark. Take three values of Wt, resolved against the TX depth: 0, the TX depth plus 1 (skipped when it is above 255) and the drawn control value (1, the drawn mid value or the TX depth). For each Wt, write CONTROL.TX_WATERMARK=Wt with the other fields kept. With ACTIVE=0 and no COMMAND, write TXDATA words (each after a STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0) to the occupancies q in increasing order from the set of 0, 1, Wt minus 1, Wt and the TX depth that lie in 0 to the TX depth. At each q, poll STATUS until TXQD=q with ACTIVE=0; that read gives TXWM. The reads of Wt 0 and of the TX depth plus 1 are graded; the reads of the control value are logged with `OBS-SPI-WM`. Run the SW_RST helper after each Wt.
. TX watermark control. Run the SPI clean state. Write CONTROL.TX_WATERMARK=1 and poll STATUS until TXWM=1, with TXQD=0 in that read.
. RX watermark. For each Wr of 0, 1 and the drawn mid value, in the drawn order, write CONTROL.RX_WATERMARK=Wr with the other fields kept. For each r in Wr minus 1 (when Wr is at least 1) and Wr plus 1, run the SPI clean state, then after a STATUS read that shows READY=1 run an Rx segment of 4*r bytes (DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0) with no RXDATA read, skipping the segment when r is 0. Wait until the segment is done, then poll STATUS until RXQD=r; that read gives RXWM. Never drive r equal to Wr. After the Wr plus 1 run of each Wr, run step 11 before the next Wr.
. RX drain and counters. After the Wr plus 1 run of each Wr, read RXDATA one word at a time until RXEMPTY=1, each read after a STATUS read that shows RXEMPTY=0. After each read, poll STATUS until RXQD is one lower; that read gives RXWM. For Wr of 1 or more, the read at RXQD equal to Wr minus 1 shows RXWM=0 (CHK-SPI-WM, crossing out). RXWM at RXQD equal to Wr is logged and not graded. Run the SW_RST helper.
. Command queue. After a STATUS read that shows READY=1, write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4 bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0) with no TX data. Poll STATUS until ACTIVE=1 and TXSTALL=1; the head segment is held. Read CMDQD as c0. Write n further COMMANDs (DIRECTION 0, LEN 0, CSAAT=0), n drawn from 1 to 3, each after a STATUS read that shows READY=1; stop when READY=0. After each accepted COMMAND, poll STATUS until CMDQD differs from its previous value; the new value is the previous value plus 1. Log CMDQD and READY. At least one COMMAND must be accepted, else CTRL-MISSING.
. Release the queue. Write one TXDATA word. Wait until the sampler has shown, after that write, one chip-select rise for the held segment and one chip-select-low window per accepted COMMAND, and STATUS shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Run the SW_RST helper.
. TX full while active. Write CONFIGOPTS with CLKDIV 3 and the other fields as in step 2. Let D be the TX depth and K a test parameter equal to D. After a STATUS read that shows READY=1, write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4*(D+K) bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0). Write TXDATA words, each after a STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0, until a STATUS read shows TXFULL=1 with ACTIVE=1; log its TXQD. When the segment is done, or all D+K words are written, without such a read, log CTRL-MISSING and fail. Write the remaining words, each after TXFULL=0. Wait until the segment is done and take the sck cycle count.
. RX full while idle. Run the SPI clean state. Run an Rx segment of exactly 4*R bytes (the drawn speed, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0), where R is the RX depth found in step 5, with no RXDATA read. Wait until the segment is done. Read STATUS; RXFULL is graded and RXQD is logged with `OBS-SPI-QD`. Capacity check: after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, write COMMAND for one more Rx segment of 4 bytes (the drawn speed, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0) with no RXDATA read. Wait until the sampler shows chip select high after that segment, or until the stall window passes with no sck edge, and read STATUS: RXQD is not above R, because a full FIFO takes no word. Then read RXDATA until the segment is done and RXEMPTY=1, each read after a STATUS read that shows RXEMPTY=0; the words read equal R+1. Run the SW_RST helper.
. Apply the flag-pair rule to every STATUS read of the seed: TXFULL and TXEMPTY are never both set, and RXFULL and RXEMPTY are never both set. Require that each of the four flags is set in at least one read of the seed.

*Checkers*:

[cols="2,5",options="header"]
|===
|Checker |Contract
|CHK-SPI-TXSTALL
|In the stall window TXSTALL=1 and no sck edge appears. After the remaining words are written, TXSTALL reads 0 and the segment ends with 4*m*8/lanes sck cycles (`spi_controller.adoc`, STATUS.TXSTALL). A host that keeps sck running without data, or that keeps TXSTALL set after the data arrives, fails. Anchor: STATUS readback and the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` (approved). Control: with all words written before the COMMAND, TXSTALL reads 0 in every STATUS read taken while the sampler shows chip select low, in the same seed, and at least one such read exists. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-TXSTALL PASS seed=<n> speed=<s> gap_clk=<g> txstall=1 sck_edges_in_stall=0 txstall_after_push=0 cycles=<got>/<exp> control_gap0_txstall=0`.
|CHK-SPI-RXSTALL
|With RXFULL=1 and RXSTALL=1, no sck edge appears in the stall window, and after the drain the segment ends with all 258 words delivered (`spi_controller.adoc`, STATUS.RXFULL, STATUS.RXSTALL). A host that keeps sck running with a full RX FIFO, or that does not resume after the reads, fails. Anchor: STATUS readback and the pad ports (approved). Control: the same segment shows sck toggles before RXFULL, so the pause has a cause. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-RXSTALL PASS seed=<n> speed=<s> rxfull=1 rxstall=1 sck_edges_in_stall=0 ctrl_toggles_before_rxfull=<t> drained_words=<w>`.
|CHK-SPI-WM
|At TX_WATERMARK 0, TXWM reads 0 at every occupancy q. At TX_WATERMARK equal to the TX depth plus 1, TXWM reads 1 at every occupancy q up to the full FIFO. For each RX_WATERMARK 0, 1 and the mid value, RXWM equals (RXQD > RX_WATERMARK) at RXQD one below and one above it (`spi_controller.adoc`, STATUS.TXWM, STATUS.RXWM). A host with the opposite polarity, with TXWM set at watermark 0, or with TXWM clear at a full FIFO below the watermark, fails. Anchor: the STATUS read that shows the expected occupancy with ACTIVE=0 (approved frontdoor). In the drain of step 11, for RX_WATERMARK 1 and the mid value, RXWM reads 0 at RXQD equal to RX_WATERMARK minus 1, so RXWM clears when the reads take RXQD below the watermark. RXWM at RXQD equal to RX_WATERMARK is not graded, because `CONTROL.RX_WATERMARK` ("reaches") and `STATUS.RXWM` ("exceeds") differ there. The TX cells at TX_WATERMARK 1, a mid value and the TX depth are controls: the open tests grade TXWM against TXQD at TX_WATERMARK 2 to 8 (`sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test`, `sep_spi_ot_dma_tx_test`), so the leaf logs them with `OBS-SPI-WM` and prints no `CHK-SPI-WM PASS` for them. Control for "TXWM never set at watermark 0": watermark 1 with TXQD 0 gives TXWM=1 in the same seed, else CTRL-MISSING. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-WM PASS seed=<n> side=<tx or rx> wm=<w> q=<q> flag=<f> expect=<e>` per graded occupancy, `CHK-SPI-WM PASS seed=<n> side=rx crossing=out wm=<w> q=<w-1> flag=0` per drain of a watermark of 1 or more, `OBS-SPI-WM seed=<n> side=tx wm=<w> q=<q> flag=<f>` per control occupancy, and `CTRL-SPI-WM seed=<n> side=tx wm=1 q=0 flag=1` for the polarity control.
|CHK-SPI-QD
|With ACTIVE=0, each RXDATA read lowers RXQD by 1 (`spi_controller.adoc`, STATUS.RXQD). TXFULL is set in a STATUS read with ACTIVE=1 during a Tx segment of 4*(D+K) bytes, and that segment ends with 4*(D+K)*8 sck cycles, so a full FIFO loses no word. R is the first idle segment length whose read shows RXFULL=1, so RXFULL below R is the search itself and is logged, not graded. After an Rx segment of exactly R, RXFULL is set; a further 4-byte Rx segment does not raise RXQD above R, and the drain then reads R+1 words, so RXFULL marks the real capacity of the RX FIFO and the held word is not lost. A host that sets RXFULL before the FIFO is full shows RXQD of R+1 after the further segment and fails. R comes from idle reads only; the RXQD of the stall window is a lower bound and is not graded. TXFULL and TXEMPTY, and RXFULL and RXEMPTY, are never both set. A host that keeps RXQD after a read, that loses a word at a full TX FIFO, or that sets both flags of a pair, fails. Anchor: STATUS readback (approved frontdoor). TXQD and RXQD at idle are logged and not graded: the open test `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` grades TXQD against the words written (CHK-WATERMARK), and entry 4.7 grades the received word count (CHK-SPI-RXCNT). Control for the flag pairs: each of the four flags is seen set in the same seed, else CTRL-MISSING. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-QD PASS seed=<n> idle=1 rxqd_step_ok=1 txfull_active=1 txfull_cycles=<got>/<exp> rxfull_at_R=1 rxqd_after_extra=<q> max=<R> words_after_extra=<w>/<R+1> pairs_both_set=0 seen_txfull=1 seen_txempty=1 seen_rxfull=1 seen_rxempty=1` and `OBS-SPI-QD seed=<n> txqd=<t> rxqd=<r>` per idle read.
|CHK-SPI-CMDQD
|CMDQD rises by 1 per accepted COMMAND while the head segment is held, and after the held segment is released every queued command runs on the pad (one chip-select-low window per accepted COMMAND after the held segment) and the queue empties (CMDQD reads 0 with ACTIVE low) (`spi_controller.adoc`, STATUS.CMDQD). A host that does not count a queued command, or that drops it, fails: a dropped command gives CMDQD 0 with fewer chip-select-low windows. Anchor: STATUS readback (approved frontdoor) and the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` (approved). Control: the head segment is held (ACTIVE=1 and TXSTALL=1) when the first COMMAND is written, and at least one COMMAND is accepted, else CTRL-MISSING. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-CMDQD PASS seed=<n> queued=<n> cmdqd=<c> ready=<r> cs_windows=<got>/<1+n> drained=1`.
|===

*Pass Criteria*: Every named checker PASSes. UVM_ERROR == 0.

*Scope limit*: The TX and RX depths are found at run time and never compared with a value. RXWM at RXQD equal to RX_WATERMARK is not graded. A watermark of 0x7F against the reset value of RX_WATERMARK is not graded, because the RX depth is not stated. TXQD and RXQD are not compared while ACTIVE=1. The values read from RXDATA are not graded. The open tests `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` and `sep_spi_ot_dma_tx_test` own their TX watermark cells; the TX cells at watermark 1, a mid value and the TX depth are controls here and are not graded. TXQD and RXQD at idle are logged and not graded. Overflow and underflow are graded in entry 4.10.

'''''

[[sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test_leg]]
===== 4.10 `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test` (extension)

*Phase*: 3 (extends an open test)

*Area*: SPI and DMA

*Run mode*: `no_cpu` (`lsu_stub_all_live`) with `+skip_fuse_sense`, as the open test, 3 seeds, the seed count of the open test entry; tool: both (Verilator and VCS); the entry of the open test in `spi.toml`, with no testlist entry added

*Source Module*: `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test`

*BFM / Model*: `ocah_axi_vip` for the register frontdoor over `s_axi` (CPU-LSU splice, approved), including 8-byte writes with a chosen strobe and the response code of every access. A test-side sampler reads the pad ports `spi_sck_o` and `spi_cs_n_o` on each core clock (approved). `sep_internal_interrupts_probe_o` index 13 is PIC source 14 (approved). No checker needs a proposed probe. No inject. No check is blocked.

*Randomization*: `SepSeededRng` from the run seed. RANDCFG: INTR_ENABLE of the L1 state reads, the source-state order and the masked kind. RAND-REP: the rest. Dimensions: one EVENT_ENABLE value (a subset of TXEMPTY, TXWM, RXFULL and RXWM) at each true state, INTR_ENABLE of the L1 state reads (0 to 3), the order of the four INTR_ENABLE values of the line walk, the kind order, the command kind of the accumulation and of the write of 0 (CSIDINVAL, CMDINVAL or CMDBUSY), the accumulation depth (2 to 3), a 6-bit clear mask (at least one injected bit inside the mask and at least one outside), the pair order, the strobe order, the data words (implemented bits only, unique per word, different from the register content), the out-of-range CSID value v (2 to 0xFFFFFFFE, uniform), the SW_RST point inside a segment, the extra TX words (1 to 4) and the queued command count n (1 to 3). `reseed = 3` samples other orders, enables, masks, command kinds, points and data. Every seed runs each source level change with its EVENT_ENABLE bit at 0 and at 1, the 16 (INTR_ENABLE, INTR_STATE) cells of the line walk (register accesses only), the five error kinds, CSIDINVAL at v (graded) and at CSID=1 (logged only), and all 12 strobe cells. The write of 0 runs over the drawn command kind with UNDERFLOW and OVERFLOW, so the `w0_on_set` cells of the command kinds in `cp_clear_form` depend on the seed and close on a merge of regressions (<<sep-fcov-rand,SEP_FCOV>>).

*Objective*: This entry extends the open test `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test`. The open test grades the reset values and the read-write walk, INTR_STATE.ERROR set by INTR_TEST and cleared by write one, SPI_EVENT following the INTR_TEST force level, PIC source 14 against INTR_ENABLE for both sources, each ERROR_STATUS kind set by its own trigger and cleared by write one, TXWM at two TX_WATERMARK values, one SPIEN hold window with OUTPUT_EN=1, the SW_RST FIFO check, and a zero-strobe half on the CONTROL register. Every cell of the open test stays as a control, and the open test keeps the grading of those cells. The four legs below add only the new cells.

* Leg L1, event sources and interrupt line (`vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, INTR_STATE, INTR_ENABLE, EVENT_ENABLE and STATUS registers; `hw/sys/sep/doc/spi.adoc`, Features; `hw/sys/sep/doc/interrupts.adoc`, SEP CPU Interrupt Vector Map; later cites in this entry use the file names only). INTR_STATE.SPI_EVENT follows the OR of the levels of the sources that EVENT_ENABLE selects. The level of IDLE is STATUS.ACTIVE low. The level of READY, TXEMPTY, RXFULL, TXWM and RXWM is the matching STATUS bit. INTR_ENABLE gates only the line into PIC source 14.
* Leg L2, error latch (`vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_ENABLE, ERROR_STATUS, INTR_STATE and STATUS.READY; `hw/sys/sep/doc/spi.adoc`, Features). Each injected condition with its ERROR_ENABLE bit set sets the latched INTR_STATE.ERROR. A clear of ERROR_STATUS leaves INTR_STATE.ERROR set. Accumulated kinds OR into ERROR_STATUS, and a write of 1 clears only the written bits. A COMMAND written while READY=0 sets CMDBUSY also when no segment is active.
* Leg L3, 8-byte writes (`hw/sys/sep/doc/spi.adoc`, Features; `vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_STATUS). An 8-byte AXI write whose strobes select one 4-byte half lands that half, leaves the other half unchanged and returns OKAY. A half with all strobes clear issues no TL-UL request and queues no TXDATA word. A forwarded half returns an error (`spi.adoc`, Features), so BRESP OKAY and an unchanged TXQD grade that the bridge does not forward the half.
* Leg L4, SW_RST and SPIEN (`vendor/lowRISC/opentitan/overlay/regs/spi_controller/regs/gen/adoc/spi_controller.adoc`, CONTROL and STATUS). CONTROL.SW_RST reads back 1 until firmware writes 0, and clears the FIFOs and the core state but not the registers. CONTROL.SPIEN=0 holds queued commands off the pad, and SPIEN=1 runs them in order.

*Test Coverage*: This entry extends `sep_spi_ot_host_csr_irq_rand_test`. Only the new cells below are graded here. The open test keeps every cell listed in the Objective. L1: SPI_EVENT from real sources (TXEMPTY, TXWM, RXWM, RXFULL, IDLE, READY) for EVENT_ENABLE 0xF and a drawn EVENT_ENABLE value at each true state, each source level change with its EVENT_ENABLE bit at 0 and at 1, INTR_ENABLE 0 to 3 with an enabled twin, the line walk of INTR_ENABLE 0 to 3 against the INTR_STATE cells none, error, event and both (11 graded cells; the five cells that the open test grades with the same stimulus are controls), the mask step and the level legs for IDLE and READY. L2: the five kinds CSIDINVAL, CMDINVAL, UNDERFLOW, OVERFLOW and CMDBUSY singly (the INTR_STATE.ERROR latch cells; the own-bit and clear cells stay with the open test) and accumulated (at most one command kind, injected first), with 6-bit clear masks that have a hit bit and a kept bit, a write of 0 with the drawn command kind set together with UNDERFLOW and OVERFLOW, CMDBUSY with ACTIVE=1 and with ACTIVE=0, and one kind injected with its ERROR_ENABLE bit clear (logged only). L2 also grades the own-bit value of CSIDINVAL at a drawn CSID from 2 to 0xFFFFFFFE and logs it at CSID=1, where the specification texts differ (<<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>); the open test drives CSID=0xFFFFFFFF. L3: four register pairs (0x00, 0x18, 0x28 and 0x30) with strobes 0x0F, 0xF0 and 0xFF (12 cells), including the TXDATA half. L4: SW_RST at a drawn point of a segment with non-reset register values, and SPIEN=0 with 1 to 3 queued commands followed by SPIEN=1. Functional coverage: `sep_spi_interrupt_cg` (`cp_event_aggregation`, `cp_intr_test`), `sep_spi_misc_rand_cg` (`cp_event_src_x_en_x_cond`, `cp_intr_en_x_state`, `cp_swrst_midseg`; graded on a merge of regressions: `cp_clear_form`), `sep_spi_error_status_cg` (`cp_error_raised_cleared`, `cp_intr_error_latch`, `cp_underflow_cell`, `cp_overflow_cell`, `cp_zero_strobe_cell`, `cp_csid_out_of_range`), `sep_spi_illegal_access_cg` (`cp_cmdbusy_cell`, `cp_spien0_cmd_write`), `sep_periph_reset_state_cg` (`cp_sw_rst_domain`, `cp_sw_rst_hold`), `sep_spi_pad_interface_cg` (`cp_spien_hold_run`) and `sep_spi_fifo_status_cg` (`cp_ready_x_active`, `cp_depth_counter`).

*Test Procedure*:

[arabic]
. Draw INTR_ENABLE (I), the EVENT_ENABLE value of each true state, the line walk order, the state order, the kind order, the command kind of the accumulation, the accumulation depth d, the clear mask, the masked kind, the pair order, the strobe order, the data words, the out-of-range CSID v, the SW_RST point t, the extra TX words and n from the seed. Every wait in the steps below is a bounded wait; a timeout fails the check that the step feeds. A segment is done when the sampler has shown chip select low and then high (for a chain with CSAAT=1, high after the last segment) and a later STATUS read shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Every wait for a segment below is this bounded wait, so a STATUS read taken before the command starts does not end it. Before every COMMAND write the test polls STATUS until READY=1 (bounded), except the last COMMAND of each CMDBUSY injection, which is written while READY=0. A "state read" samples STATUS, INTR_STATE (SPI_EVENT and ERROR) and PIC source 14 with INTR_ENABLE=I, then writes INTR_ENABLE=3 and samples PIC source 14 again (the enabled twin), then restores INTR_ENABLE=I. The SW_RST helper writes CONTROL.SW_RST=1 with the other fields kept, polls STATUS until TXEMPTY=1 and RXEMPTY=1, then writes CONTROL.SW_RST=0. The SPI clean state writes 1 to every bit of ERROR_STATUS and to INTR_STATE.ERROR, writes CSID=0, and runs the SW_RST helper.
. Start from the harness reset state. Write CONTROL with SPIEN=1, OUTPUT_EN=1 and SW_RST=0, CONFIGOPTS with CLKDIV 1 and the other fields 0, and CSID=0. ERROR_ENABLE keeps its reset value 0x1F. Read INTR_STATE.ERROR; it reads 0 (control for the latch).
. L1, quiet states. Steps 3 and 4 run in two passes. Pass A writes EVENT_ENABLE=0xF (TXEMPTY, TXWM, RXFULL and RXWM) before each set-up and pass B writes EVENT_ENABLE=0; each pass writes its value again before every SPI clean state that ends a state. The RXFULL-only sequence of step 6 also runs a second time with EVENT_ENABLE=0 in place of RXFULL. So each level change of TXEMPTY, TXWM, RXFULL and RXWM in a set-up or a clean state happens once with the bit of the source at 1 and once at 0. In pass B and in the second RXFULL run every state read expects SPI_EVENT=0. Run the SPI clean state. Write the EVENT_ENABLE value of the pass and INTR_ENABLE=I. State F: write TX_WATERMARK=1 and RX_WATERMARK=2, write 2 TXDATA words, and poll STATUS until TXQD=2 with ACTIVE=0. STATUS shows TXEMPTY=0, TXWM=0, RXFULL=0 and RXWM=0. Take a state read. Expected SPI_EVENT=0.
. L1, true states in the drawn order. Each state starts from the SPI clean state. State T1 (TXEMPTY): TX_WATERMARK=0 and TXQD=0. State T2 (TXWM): TX_WATERMARK=2 and 1 TXDATA word. State T3 (RXWM): TX_WATERMARK=0, 1 TXDATA word, RX_WATERMARK=2 and an Rx segment of 12 bytes, which leaves RXQD=3. State T4 (TXEMPTY and TXWM together): TX_WATERMARK=2 and TXQD=0. For T3, wait until the Rx segment is done and a STATUS read shows RXQD=3 with ACTIVE=0. Read STATUS and require the named levels, else CTRL-MISSING. In pass A, take a state read with EVENT_ENABLE=0xF, then write the drawn value of the state to EVENT_ENABLE and take a second state read; in pass B take one state read. Expected SPI_EVENT equals the OR, over the bits that EVENT_ENABLE holds at the read, of the named levels, so a read with no selected source true expects 0.
. L1, TXEMPTY-only sequence. Run the SPI clean state. Write EVENT_ENABLE=TXEMPTY only and TX_WATERMARK=0. State read: SPI_EVENT=1. Mask step: write EVENT_ENABLE=0 while STATUS shows TXEMPTY=1, take a state read (SPI_EVENT=0), restore EVENT_ENABLE=TXEMPTY. Write 1 TXDATA word; state read (SPI_EVENT=0). Write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4 bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0), wait until the segment is done, and take a state read (SPI_EVENT=1).
. L1, RXFULL-only sequence. Run the SPI clean state. Write EVENT_ENABLE=RXFULL only. State read: SPI_EVENT=0. Write COMMAND for an Rx segment of 1032 bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 1, CSAAT=0) and read no RXDATA. Poll STATUS until RXFULL=1 and RXSTALL=1, and take a state read (SPI_EVENT=1). Read RXDATA until the segment is done and RXEMPTY=1, each read after a STATUS read that shows RXEMPTY=0. State read: SPI_EVENT=0.
. L1, IDLE level leg. Run the SPI clean state. Write EVENT_ENABLE=IDLE only. State read: ACTIVE=0 and SPI_EVENT=1. Write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4 bytes with no TX data. Poll STATUS until ACTIVE=1 and TXSTALL=1, and take a state read (SPI_EVENT=0). Write one TXDATA word, wait until the segment is done, and take a state read (SPI_EVENT=1).
. L1, READY level leg. Run the SPI clean state. Write EVENT_ENABLE=READY only. State read: READY=1 and SPI_EVENT=1. Write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4 bytes with no TX data, poll STATUS until ACTIVE=1 and TXSTALL=1, then write dummy COMMANDs (DIRECTION 0, LEN 0, CSAAT=0), each after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, until a STATUS read shows READY=0. When READY=1 after 16 accepted writes, log CTRL-MISSING and fail. In the READY-low window take a state read with EVENT_ENABLE=READY (SPI_EVENT=0), write EVENT_ENABLE=0 and take a state read (SPI_EVENT=0), then restore EVENT_ENABLE=READY. Write one TXDATA word, wait until ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0, and take a state read (READY=1 and SPI_EVENT=1). Then the line walk: for each INTR_ENABLE value 0 to 3 in the drawn order, run the SPI clean state, write EVENT_ENABLE=0 and the INTR_ENABLE value, and read the line in four states in this order: none (INTR_STATE.ERROR and SPI_EVENT clear), error (after a write of INTR_TEST.ERROR=1), both (after a write of EVENT_ENABLE=TXEMPTY with TXQD=0), event (after a write of 1 to INTR_STATE.ERROR), and none again after a write of EVENT_ENABLE=0. Each line read samples INTR_STATE and PIC source 14 (CHK-SPI-LINE). The five cells that the open test grades with the same stimulus, (INTR_ENABLE 0, 1 and 2, none) and (INTR_ENABLE 0 and 1, error), are controls: each logs `CTL-SPI-LINE LOG seed=<n> intr_en=<v> state=<s> pic14=<got> expect=<exp>`, a mismatch fails the leaf, and no CHK-SPI-LINE line is printed for it.
. L2, single kinds (Phase A). For each of the five kinds in the drawn order, run the SPI clean state, write INTR_ENABLE=0 and EVENT_ENABLE=0, read ERROR_STATUS and INTR_STATE.ERROR (both 0), then inject the kind as error injection, with every COMMAND write after a STATUS read that shows READY=1 (the last COMMAND of the CMDBUSY kind is the one write that skips it): point CSID register write then COMMAND, kind out-of-range CSID, CSID=v, then a dummy COMMAND, then CSID=0, expected ERROR_STATUS.CSIDINVAL=1; point COMMAND write, kind SPEED=3, expected CMDINVAL=1; point RXDATA read with RXEMPTY=1 and ACTIVE=0, kind read of an empty RX FIFO (the value is not graded), expected UNDERFLOW=1; point TXDATA write with TXFULL=1, kind write to a full TX FIFO (write TXDATA after each STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0 until one shows TXFULL=1, then once more), expected OVERFLOW=1; point COMMAND write while READY=0 with ACTIVE=1, kind a COMMAND written while the head segment is held in a TXSTALL and the queue is full (write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4 bytes with no TX data, poll STATUS until ACTIVE=1 and TXSTALL=1, write dummy COMMANDs while STATUS shows READY=1 until it shows READY=0, then write one more COMMAND), expected CMDBUSY=1. Each expected response also includes INTR_STATE.ERROR=1. The CSIDINVAL kind runs twice: with the drawn out-of-range value v (graded) and with CSID=1 (logged only). Before the first CSIDINVAL injection, with CSID=0, write a dummy COMMAND, wait until the segment is done and read ERROR_STATUS (0). `sep_io` has one chip select (`spi.adoc`, Features: `NUM_CS = 1`) and the core asserts `cio_csb_o[CSID]` for a command (`spi_host.hjson`, CSID), so 0 is the only valid CSID. `ERROR_ENABLE.CSIDINVAL` raises the error when CSID exceeds NumCS (`spi_host.hjson`, ERROR_ENABLE), and CSID=1 does not exceed NumCS=1, so the two texts differ at CSID=1 (<<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>). Every value from 2 to 0xFFFFFFFF exceeds NumCS and selects no chip-select line, so both texts make it invalid. The open test drives 0xFFFFFFFF.
. For each kind of step 9, poll ERROR_STATUS until the kind's own bit reads 1 and log that read (CMDBUSY 0x01, OVERFLOW 0x02, UNDERFLOW 0x04, CMDINVAL 0x08, CSIDINVAL 0x10). For the CSIDINVAL kind at v, CHK-SPI-CSID-RANGE grades that it equals 0x10 alone; at CSID=1 the leaf logs the read as `OBS-SPI-CSID1 LOG csid=0x1 err_status=0x<g> intr_error=<e>` and grades nothing; for the other kinds the open test grades that it equals that bit alone. Read INTR_STATE.ERROR (1). Write 1 to that ERROR_STATUS bit; ERROR_STATUS reads 0 (a control, graded by the open test) and INTR_STATE.ERROR still reads 1. Write 1 to INTR_STATE.ERROR; it reads 0. After the CMDBUSY kind, write one TXDATA word and wait until ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Then run the SPI clean state.
. L2, accumulation (Phase B). An error bit must be cleared before any further command is issued (`spi_host.hjson`, ERROR_STATUS), so each accumulation holds at most one of the command kinds CSIDINVAL, CMDINVAL and CMDBUSY and injects it first. The later kinds are UNDERFLOW and OVERFLOW, which issue no command. Run the SPI clean state. Inject d kinds as in step 9, without clearing ERROR_STATUS: the drawn command kind first, then the first d - 1 of UNDERFLOW and OVERFLOW in the drawn order. Run the SW_RST helper after each injection (it clears the internal state and not the registers; the READY=1 poll precedes each COMMAND write that follows it), so that no kind starts from the queue or FIFO state of an earlier kind. The CSIDINVAL injection of this phase uses the drawn value v. Write CSID=0 after it. After the last injection, read ERROR_STATUS as old; it equals the OR of the bits of the injected kinds. Write the drawn 6-bit mask to ERROR_STATUS and read it again; it equals old and not mask. Require `hit` (mask and old) and `kept` (old and not mask) both non-zero, else CTRL-MISSING. Run the SPI clean state. Then inject the drawn command kind, UNDERFLOW and OVERFLOW in this order and in the same way, write 0 to ERROR_STATUS and read it again; it equals the OR of the three bits, because a write of 0 clears no bit. Run the SPI clean state.
. L2, masked kind (Phase C). Write ERROR_ENABLE=0x1F with the bit of the masked kind clear. Inject that kind as in step 9. Read ERROR_STATUS and INTR_STATE.ERROR and log them; they are not graded. Write ERROR_ENABLE=0x1F and run the SPI clean state.
. L2, CMDBUSY with ACTIVE low. Run the SPI clean state. Write CONTROL.SPIEN=0 with ERROR_ENABLE=0x1F. Write dummy COMMANDs (DIRECTION 0, LEN 0, CSAAT=0), each after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, and read ERROR_STATUS after each; CMDBUSY stays 0 (control). Stop at the first STATUS read that shows READY=0 and ACTIVE=0. When READY=1 after 16 accepted writes, log CTRL-MISSING and fail (CMDQD is 4 bits wide). Point: COMMAND write while READY=0 with ACTIVE=0. Kind: one more COMMAND. Expected response: ERROR_STATUS.CMDBUSY=1. After that read, write 1 to ERROR_STATUS.CMDBUSY, so that no error bit is set when the queued commands run. Write CONTROL.SPIEN=1, wait until the sampler has shown one chip-select-low window per accepted command and STATUS shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0, and run the SPI clean state.
. L3, strobe cells. For each of the four pairs in the drawn order and each strobe 0x0F, 0xF0 and 0xFF in the drawn order, run the SPI clean state. Write CONTROL (SPIEN=1, SW_RST=0), CONFIGOPTS=0, CSID=0, ERROR_ENABLE=0x1F, INTR_ENABLE=0 and EVENT_ENABLE=0 with 4-byte writes. Apply the condition of the pair table below, so that every write-one-to-clear half holds a set bit that the data clears and every read-write half holds a value that differs from the data. The data of a write-one-to-clear half carries every implemented bit. For the pair at 0x30 the condition is error injection: point COMMAND write after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, kind reserved SPEED encoding (SPEED=3, DIRECTION 0, LEN 0, CSAAT=0), expected response ERROR_STATUS.CMDINVAL=1; poll ERROR_STATUS until CMDINVAL reads 1 and require the value 0x08 before the strobed write.
. For each strobe cell, read both registers of the pair (TXDATA is not read), issue one 8-byte write at the aligned pair offset with the drawn data words and the strobe, and read both registers again. Point: 8-byte write on the register bus. Kind: strobe 0x00 on the unselected half of a 0x0F or 0xF0 beat. Expected response: OKAY with no write on that half. A beat with all eight strobes clear is not driven, because the AXI master emits no such beat. When ERROR_STATUS is not one of the pair, read it and log ACCESSINVAL.
. For the pair at 0x28, with ACTIVE=0: after strobe 0x0F or 0xFF, poll STATUS until TXQD=1; after strobe 0xF0, read STATUS (TXQD=0 and TXEMPTY=1). Then after a STATUS read that shows READY=1 write COMMAND for a Tx segment of 4 bytes (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0), write one TXDATA word after strobe 0xF0 only, and wait until the segment is done. Read STATUS; TXEMPTY=1 and TXQD=0, so the empty half queues no spurious word. Run the SW_RST helper after the cell.
. L4, SW_RST. Run the SPI clean state. Write drawn non-reset values, each different from its reset value, to CONFIGOPTS, ERROR_ENABLE, EVENT_ENABLE and CONTROL (SPIEN=1, OUTPUT_EN=1, a non-zero TX_WATERMARK and an RX_WATERMARK other than 0x7F). Read each register and log it. Write COMMAND for a Tx segment (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 2, CSAAT=0) and write the words that it consumes plus the drawn 1 to 4 extra TXDATA words, each after a STATUS read that shows TXFULL=0. Write CONTROL.SW_RST=1 (other fields kept) when the sampler shows t sck cycles of the segment, with t drawn from 1 to half of the segment's sck cycles.
. Read STATUS immediately before the SW_RST write and log ACTIVE, TXQD and RXQD. When ACTIVE=0 and TXQD+RXQD=0, log CTRL-MISSING and fail. After the write, read CONTROL; SW_RST reads 1. Poll STATUS until TXEMPTY=1 and RXEMPTY=1. Write CONTROL.SW_RST=0 with the other fields kept. Read STATUS: ACTIVE, TXQD and RXQD read 0. Read CONFIGOPTS, ERROR_ENABLE, EVENT_ENABLE and the other CONTROL fields; they hold the non-reset values. Poll STATUS until READY=1, write one clean command (SPEED 0, DIRECTION 0, a drawn LEN, CSAAT=0), wait until the segment is done, and take its sck cycle count.
. L4, SPIEN. Run the SPI clean state. Draw n distinct LEN values. With SPIEN=1 and ACTIVE=0, run one dummy segment (DIRECTION 0, the largest drawn LEN, CSAAT=0) and take its chip-select-low time T. Write CONTROL.SPIEN=0. Write n dummy COMMANDs with the drawn LEN values (DIRECTION 0, CSAAT=0), each after a STATUS read that shows READY=1, and stop when READY=0. Read STATUS; log CMDQD and the number of accepted commands, which is at least 1, else CTRL-MISSING.
. Sample the pad ports for 4*T core clocks after the last accepted COMMAND, a window that is a test parameter. Write CONTROL.SPIEN=1. Wait until the sampler has shown one chip-select-low window per accepted command and STATUS shows ACTIVE=0 and CMDQD=0. Take the chip-select-low windows and their sck cycle counts in order.

[cols="1,3,5",options="header"]
|===
|Offset |Pair (leg L3) |Condition before each cell
|0x00 |INTR_STATE, INTR_ENABLE |INTR_STATE.ERROR set through INTR_TEST.
|0x18 |CONFIGOPTS, CSID |None.
|0x28 |TXDATA, ERROR_ENABLE |ACTIVE=0 and both FIFOs empty. The TXDATA half is graded by TXQD.
|0x30 |ERROR_STATUS, EVENT_ENABLE |ERROR_STATUS.CMDINVAL set by the COMMAND injection of this step (SPEED=3).
|===

The offsets come from `spi_controller.adoc`, and TXDATA at 0x28 and RXDATA at 0x24 from `spi_controller.rdl`. The pairs at 0x08 (INTR_TEST, ALERT_TEST) and 0x20 (COMMAND, RXDATA) are not used, because a write has an effect that the register description leaves open or launches a command. The pair at 0x10 (CONTROL, STATUS) is not used, because the open test grades its CONTROL half and the response to a write to the read-only STATUS is not stated. STATUS is not compared with a literal (see <<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>).

*Checkers*:

[cols="2,5",options="header"]
|===
|Checker |Contract
|CHK-SPI-EVENT
|At each state read, SPI_EVENT equals the OR of the levels of the selected sources, also with INTR_ENABLE=0, equals 0 after the mask step, and follows the IDLE and READY levels in their legs (`spi_controller.adoc`, INTR_STATE.SPI_EVENT, EVENT_ENABLE; `spi.adoc`, Features). A source that is not selected never sets SPI_EVENT, and a stuck SPI_EVENT fails. Anchor: INTR_STATE and STATUS readback (approved frontdoor), with the source levels named by the stimulus. Control for "SPI_EVENT stays 0": the same seed holds a state with a selected source true and reads SPI_EVENT=1 (the TXEMPTY-only sequence), and the READY-low state with EVENT_ENABLE.READY=0 is read next to a READY-low state with EVENT_ENABLE.READY=1. A read pair taken while STATUS shows another level than the one named fails with CTRL-MISSING. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-EVENT PASS seed=<n> ev_en=0x<e> src=<ids> level=<bits> event=<got> expect=<exp> mask_step=<0 or 1>`.
|CHK-SPI-LINE
|PIC source 14 equals (SPI_EVENT and INTR_ENABLE.SPI_EVENT) or (ERROR and INTR_ENABLE.ERROR) (`interrupts.adoc`, SEP CPU Interrupt Vector Map; `spi.adoc`, Features). A line stuck low, stuck high, or not gated by INTR_ENABLE fails. Anchor: `sep_internal_interrupts_probe_o` index 13 (approved). Control: the twin window with INTR_ENABLE=3 shows source 14 = 1 for a state with SPI_EVENT=1, so a stuck-low line fails also when the drawn INTR_ENABLE is 0. The line walk reads all 16 (INTR_ENABLE, INTR_STATE) cells on every seed and grades the 11 cells that the open test does not grade; the other five print `CTL-SPI-LINE LOG` (step 8). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-LINE PASS seed=<n> intr_en=<v> state=<s> pic14=<got> expect=<exp> twin_pic14=<t>` per state read, and `CHK-SPI-LINE PASS seed=<n> walk=1 intr_en=<v> state=<none\|error\|both\|event> pic14=<got> expect=<exp>` per graded line read of the walk.
|CHK-SPI-ERR-KIND
|Each real kind, injected with its ERROR_ENABLE bit set, sets INTR_STATE.ERROR, INTR_STATE.ERROR stays 1 after the ERROR_STATUS write-one-to-clear, and it clears only by its own write-one-to-clear (`spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_STATUS, INTR_STATE; `spi.adoc`, Features). A host that does not latch the error, that clears the latch with the ERROR_STATUS write, or that keeps it after the INTR_STATE write fails. Anchor: INTR_STATE readback (approved frontdoor). Control for the latch: INTR_STATE.ERROR reads 0 before the first injection, and reads 1 immediately before the ERROR_STATUS clear, so the held read is a held latch. The own-bit rule and the ERROR_STATUS clear of each kind are logged as controls and graded by the open test. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-ERR-KIND PASS seed=<n> kind=<k> intr_error=1 after_status_w1c=1 after_intr_w1c=0 control_intr_error_before=0` and the logged `err_status=0x<v>`.
|CHK-SPI-CSID-RANGE
|A COMMAND with the drawn value v (2 to 0xFFFFFFFE) sets ERROR_STATUS to 0x10 (CSIDINVAL alone) and INTR_STATE.ERROR to 1 (`spi.adoc`, Features: `NUM_CS = 1`; `spi_host.hjson`, CSID, ERROR_ENABLE.CSIDINVAL and ERROR_STATUS.CSIDINVAL: v exceeds NumCS and selects no chip-select line). A host that accepts a mid-range CSID, or that sets another error bit, fails. CSID=1 is not graded: the two texts differ there (<<sep-vplan-phase3-blocked,Blocked features>>), and the leaf logs it as `OBS-SPI-CSID1 LOG`. Anchor: ERROR_STATUS and INTR_STATE readback (approved frontdoor); the expected value comes from the injected kind. Control: a COMMAND with CSID=0 after the SPI clean state leaves ERROR_STATUS at 0, so a host that flags every CSID fails. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-CSID-RANGE PASS seed=<n> csid=0x<v> err_status=0x<g> expect=0x10 intr_error=1 control_csid0_err_status=0x00`.
|CHK-SPI-ERR-MASK
|The accumulated ERROR_STATUS equals the OR of the bits of the injected kinds, and after the drawn clear mask it equals (old and not mask) (`spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_STATUS). A clear that does nothing, or one that clears every bit, fails. Anchor: ERROR_STATUS readback (approved frontdoor). Control: `hit` (mask and old) and `kept` (old and not mask) are both non-zero, else CTRL-MISSING. With the drawn command kind, UNDERFLOW and OVERFLOW set, a write of 0 leaves ERROR_STATUS at the OR of the bits of the three injected kinds; the expected value comes from the injected kinds, not from a read-back. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-ERR-MASK PASS seed=<n> kinds=<list> old=0x<o> mask=0x<m> hit=0x<h> kept=0x<k> got=0x<g> expect=0x<e>` and `CHK-SPI-ERR-MASK PASS seed=<n> zero_write=1 cmd_kind=<k> got=0x<g> expect=0x<OR of the three kind bits>`. The masked-kind injection logs `OBS-SPI-MASK seed=<n> kind=<k> err_status=0x<v> intr_error=<b>` and grades nothing.
|CHK-SPI-CMDBUSY0
|A COMMAND written while READY=0 and ACTIVE=0 sets CMDBUSY (`spi_controller.adoc`, ERROR_STATUS.CMDBUSY). A host that sets CMDBUSY only while a segment is active fails. Anchor: ERROR_STATUS and STATUS readback (approved frontdoor). Control: the COMMAND writes while READY=1 left CMDBUSY clear. When READY stays 1 after 16 accepted writes, the leaf fails with CTRL-MISSING (CMDQD is 4 bits wide, `spi_controller.adoc`, STATUS.CMDQD). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-CMDBUSY0 PASS seed=<n> writes=<w> error_enable=0x1F ready=0 active=0 cmdbusy=1 control_cmdbusy=0`.
|CHK-SPI-STRB
|BRESP is OKAY, the strobed half follows its register type (read-write bits equal the data, write-one-to-clear bits equal old and not data), and the other half keeps its old value (`spi.adoc`, Features). A host that writes both halves, or that returns an error for the empty half, fails. Anchor: BRESP and register readback (approved frontdoor), compared on the implemented writable bits. The TXDATA half is graded in CHK-SPI-STRB-TX. ERROR_STATUS.ACCESSINVAL is logged and not graded, because no stimulus sets it and a read of 0 has no control. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-STRB PASS seed=<n> off=0x<o> strb=0x<s> resp=OKAY lo=0x<lo> hi=0x<hi> expect_lo=0x<e0> expect_hi=0x<e1>`, and `OBS-SPI-STRB-ACCESSINVAL seed=<n> off=0x<o> strb=0x<s> accessinval=<v>`.
|CHK-SPI-STRB-TX
|Strobe 0x0F on the pair at 0x28 raises TXQD by 1. Strobe 0xF0 leaves TXQD unchanged and TXEMPTY set, so a half with no strobes queues no TXDATA word (`spi.adoc`, Features). After the Tx segment that follows the cell, TXEMPTY=1 and TXQD=0, so no spurious word is left in the FIFO. A host that forwards the empty half, or that drops the strobed half, fails. Anchor: STATUS readback with ACTIVE=0 (approved frontdoor). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-STRB-TX PASS seed=<n> strb=0x<s> txqd_before=<a> txqd_after=<b> txempty=<t> txempty_after_segment=1`.
|CHK-SPI-STRB-CTRL
|Control for "the other half is unchanged": strobe 0xFF on each pair changes both halves in the same seed, so an unchanged half in the other cells is a strobe effect and not a dead register. Anchor: register readback and STATUS readback (approved frontdoor). Evidence: `CHK-SPI-STRB-CTRL PASS seed=<n> off=0x<o> strb=0xFF both_changed=1`.
|CHK-SPI-SWRST
|CONTROL.SW_RST reads back 1, then both FIFOs are empty, and after the write of 0 ACTIVE, TXQD and RXQD read 0 while the registers keep the non-reset values (`spi_controller.adoc`, CONTROL.SW_RST). A host that clears the registers, or that keeps a word, fails. Anchor: CONTROL and STATUS readback and the pad ports (approved). Control for the work: before the SW_RST write ACTIVE=1 or TXQD+RXQD is at least 1, else CTRL-MISSING. Control for the registers: each value differs from its reset value. Control for the release: a clean command completes with the expected sck cycle count. Evidence: `CHK-SPI-SWRST PASS seed=<n> t=<t> active_before=<a> txqd_before=<b> rxqd_before=<c> hold_read=1 txempty=1 rxempty=1 active=0 txqd=0 rxqd=0 regs_kept=1 nonreset=<count> clean_cycles=<got>/<exp>`.
|CHK-SPI-SPIEN
